ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Leave me whom I created alone' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights Allah's strategic 'allowance' (tadhir) of the disbeliever, often identified as Abu Jahl, to proceed in his misguidance as a form of gradual punishment and divine wisdom. The term 'khalaqtu wahidan' emphasizes the unique creation of the disbeliever without a father, underscing his solitary accountability before God. This reflects the principle that divine decree permits the path of the misguided to remain open until the appointed time of reckoning.
